conventions.convention: Seeds are smooth on a nonempty oriented smooth three-manifold without boundary; ψ is strictly positive. The seed definition imposes no constraint equation or development claim.
h=ψ⁴h̄, K=(τ/3)h+ψ⁻²Ā with Ā trace-free relative to h̄; E=ψ⁻⁶Ē and B=ψ⁻⁶B̄ are contravariant geometric vectors. SI vectors are e=α⁻¹E and b=α⁻¹B, where α²=κ/(2μ₀).
The Laplacian is Δh̄ψ=h̄ⁱʲD̄ᵢ∂ⱼψ, with Euclidean sign Δ=Σᵢ∂ᵢ². Spatial scalar curvature uses the inherited Gauss–Codazzi convention with K=+(1/2)ℒₙh.
The momentum equation is separate from the scalar constraint: DʲKⱼᵢ−Dᵢτ=−2ψ⁻⁶(Ē×h̄B̄)ᵢ, with the barred cross product lowered using h̄.
The RN family has m>0, signed q∈ℝ, and r>max{0,(|q|−m)/2}; ψ is the positive square root. All equations concern the stated smooth domain and make no distributional assertion at r=0.

For centered spheres the chosen normal points toward increasing r: ν=ψ⁻²∂r. Mean curvature is H=divhν, and minimal means H=0. The two asymptotically Euclidean ends and static exterior comparison require m>|q|.

load_bearing.statement: For the smooth conformal seed, the SI Maxwell constraints are equivalent to D̄ᵢĒⁱ=D̄ᵢB̄ⁱ=0, and the SI Hamiltonian constraint is equivalent to −8Δh̄ψ+R̄ψ−|Ā|²h̄ψ⁻⁷+((2/3)τ²−2Λ)ψ⁵−2(|Ē|²h̄+|B̄|²h̄)ψ⁻³=0. The separate momentum equation remains DʲKⱼᵢ−Dᵢτ=−2ψ⁻⁶(Ē×h̄B̄)ᵢ.
For the stated smooth seed data with ψ>0 and trace-free Ā, define h:=ψ⁴h̄, K:=(τ/3)h+ψ⁻²Ā, E:=ψ⁻⁶Ē, and B:=ψ⁻⁶B̄.

For m>0 and q∈ℝ on the stated positive domain, ψ(r)=sqrt((1+m/(2r))²−q²/(4r²)), h̄=dr²+r²γS², Ē=qr⁻²∂r, and B̄=Ā=τ=Λ=0 satisfy the transformed constraints and hence the corresponding SI constraints. For m>|q|, the unique minimal centered sphere is at r₀=(1/2)sqrt(m²−q²); both ends have the stated asymptotically Euclidean falloffs, and the branch r>r₀ agrees with the static RN spatial exterior.

published_dependencies.used_for: The positive symbolic SI parameters, κ=8πG/c⁴, α²=κ/(2μ₀), and geometric electromagnetic and mass/charge length conventions. Its relevant formulas agree with the seed and constraint lemma.
The smooth abstract spatial data, SI Maxwell and Hamiltonian constraints, orientation-defined cross product, and negative momentum-source sign. These match the lemma's F2 and substitutions.

The curvature operator and contraction conventions, positive second fundamental form convention, and Hamiltonian/momentum normal projections. The statement and proof were checked against the conformal curvature calculation.
The RN comparator with f(R)=1−2m/R+q²/R² and spatial coefficients f(R)⁻¹dR²+R²γS² on the static exterior. The proposition uses only this explicitly restricted metric comparison.

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplier interfaces against def-emg-fx-dirichlet-constraint-problem and the downstream small-Dirichlet theorem. The specialization h̄=δ, Ā=τ=Λ=0, Ē=εĒ₀, B̄=εB̄₀ gives exactly −8Δψ=2ε²Sψ⁻³. The consumer explicitly separates the general Hölder scalar problem from smooth prescribed-field specialization and asserts no momentum constraint. Conversely, emg-fx01 supplies identities and explicit RN data, without claiming the bounded-domain existence result established on emg-fx02.
